      repeated once to become even-length before being handed to Skia's

html-compiler.layout.block-flow-margin-c.stampedHtml:
Collapse ON: no padding/border, overflow visible. Gap = max(parent 0, child 40) = 40px above the parent, child flush at parent top.
Blocked by padding-top: 1px. Parent stays flush at the anchor (0px); child sits 41px inside the parent.
Blocked by overflow: hidden. Parent flush at the anchor (0px); child sits 40px inside the parent.
Blocked by display: flex. Flex items never collapse margins; child sits 40px inside the parent.
Sibling adjacency: margin-bottom 30px meets margin-top 50px. Gap = max(30, 50) = 50px, not the sum 80px.
display: contents wrapper between parent and child. Collapse recurses through it to the real child (40px), same signature as case A.
